title: Home Work 2: Performance Comparison: Before vs After Index
description: Сравнение производительности до и после добавления индекса

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  thread_count,
  index_status,
  AVG(response_time)::int as avg_response_time
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE success = true
GROUP BY thread_count, index_status
ORDER BY thread_count, index_status

SELECT 
  thread_count,
  index_status,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = true) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as success_rate
FROM jmeter_results 
GROUP BY thread_count, index_status
ORDER BY thread_count, index_status

SELECT 
  thread_count || ' threads' as metric,
  AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN response_time END) as "До индекса",
  AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN response_time END) as "После индекса"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count as "Потоки",
  index_status as "Статус",
  MIN(response_time) as "Min",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) as "P50",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) as "P90",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) as "P95",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time) as "P99",
  MAX(response_time) as "Max"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE success = true
GROUP BY thread_count, index_status
ORDER BY thread_count, index_status

SELECT 
  thread_count as "Потоки",
  index_status as "Статус",
  COUNT(*) as "Всего запросов",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = true) as "Успешные",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = false) as "Ошибки",
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE success = true) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as "Успешность %"
FROM jmeter_results 
GROUP BY thread_count, index_status
ORDER BY thread_count, index_status

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    thread_count,
    AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'before' THEN response_time END) as before_avg,
    AVG(CASE WHEN index_status = 'after' THEN response_time END) as after_avg,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'before' AND success = true) as before_success,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'after' AND success = true) as after_success,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'before') as before_total,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE index_status = 'after') as after_total
  FROM jmeter_results 
  GROUP BY thread_count
)
SELECT 
  thread_count as "Потоки",
  ROUND(before_avg::numeric, 1) as "До индекса (мс)",
  ROUND(after_avg::numeric, 1) as "После индекса (мс)",
  ROUND(((before_avg - after_avg) / before_avg * 100)::numeric, 1) as "Улучшение %",
  ROUND((before_success * 100.0 / before_total)::numeric, 1) as "Успешность до %",
  ROUND((after_success * 100.0 / after_total)::numeric, 1) as "Успешность после %"
FROM stats
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count || ' threads' as metric,
  AVG(response_time) as "Average",
  MIN(response_time) as "Min",
  MAX(response_time) as "Max"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE index_status = 'before' AND success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count || ' threads' as metric,
  ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000)) - MIN(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000)))), 2) as "RPS"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE index_status = 'before' AND success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count || ' threads' as metric,
  AVG(response_time) as "Average",
  MIN(response_time) as "Min",
  MAX(response_time) as "Max"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE index_status = 'after' AND success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count

SELECT 
  thread_count || ' threads' as metric,
  ROUND(COUNT(*)::numeric / EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000)) - MIN(to_timestamp(timestamp_ms / 1000)))), 2) as "RPS"
FROM jmeter_results 
WHERE index_status = 'after' AND success = true
GROUP BY thread_count
ORDER BY thread_count
